label: Salt-bridge formation, 6-statistic-prefix hybrid uncertainty across horizons and proposals
phenomenon: salt-bridge formation (K15 expanded conditions + G19 rebuilt generated means)

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (30 test proteins, sampled with replacement; unlike the 2-protein bases, the bootstrap distribution takes many distinct values)
bootstrap.note: AUPRC inside the bootstrap uses a numpy reimplementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (same threshold-grouping treatment of ties); it was verified to agree with sklearn to 1e-12 on all fitted conditions before use. Models were retrained per condition and horizon; pooled AUPRCs were verified against G108/G112 records to 4 decimal places.
